text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software reaches users. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project better. In addition, regular reviews improve the overall quality of the team's work. Everyone becomes more careful and writes cleaner code when they know someone will check it. For these reasons, code reviews are a valuable habit for any development team.
